meta.name: tools-ui
meta.description: Tool lifecycle UI components for React/Next.js from ui.inference.sh. Display tool calls: pending, progress, approval required, results. Capabilities: tool status, progress indicators, approval flows, results display. Use for: showing agent tool calls, human-in-the-loop approvals, tool output. Triggers: tool ui, tool calls, tool status, tool approval, tool results, agent tools, mcp tools ui, function calling ui, tool lifecycle, tool pending

copy.tagline: 在 React 应用中展示工具调用全生命周期
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在 React 应用中需要展示 AI 代理的工具调用状态和审批流程。
copy.tagline_en: Display tool call lifecycle in React apps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to show AI agent tool calls and approval flows in a React app.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能显示工具调用的状态（等待、运行中、需审批、成功、失败）和结果，并支持人工审批流程。
howto.when: 当 Claude 调用工具（如搜索、发送邮件）时，或需要你审批工具执行时触发。

say.text: 帮我搜索最新AI新闻，显示工具状态。
say.note: 触发搜索工具并显示运行状态

say.text: 发送邮件给user@example.com，需要我审批。
say.note: 触发需审批的邮件发送工具

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can display tool call states (pending, running, approval, success, error) and results, and support human-in-the-loop approval flows.
howto.when_en: Triggered when Claude invokes a tool (e.g., search, send email) or when human approval is required for a tool execution.

say_en.text: Search the web for latest AI news and show tool status.
say_en.note: Triggers search tool with status display

say_en.text: Send email to user@example.com, require my approval.
say_en.note: Triggers email tool with approval flow
